svg.title: Monitored device wiring: ESP32, DHT11 with 10 kΩ pull-up, SG90 servo
svg.desc: Board held with the printed pin names facing you, USB at the bottom, 3.3V top right. DHT11 leg 1 (VCC) to 3.3V with a red jumper; DHT11 leg 2 (DATA) to P4 with a yellow jumper; DHT11 leg 4 (GND) to GND with a black jumper; Servo orange (signal) to P5 with a orange jumper; Servo red (+5 V) to 5V with a red jumper; Servo brown (ground) to GND with a brown jumper. The 10 kΩ resistor is soldered across DHT11 legs 1 and 2; leg 3 is not used.

g.text: ESP32 (38-pin) + DHT11 temperature sensor with a 10 kΩ resistor + SG90 servo. Six jumper wires, one plug per pin.

svg.text: Servo wires: brown = ground, red = +5 V, orange = signal
from the servo plug to the board
DHT11, grille facing you, legs down
